## Components

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  user([User]) --> web[Web app<br/>apps/web]
  web -->|HTTPS JSON| api[API service<br/>services/api]
  api --> db[(PostgreSQL)]
  api -->|async| mail[[Email provider]]
```

Pattern: **monolith** (ADR-001). Folders match `sixloom layout`.

| Component | Folder | Owns | Writes | Why it exists |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Web app (interface `web`) | `apps/web` | UI, client validation | — | every feature |
| API service (service `api`) | `services/api` | business rules, auth | Project, Task, Membership | every feature |
| PostgreSQL | — | durable state | — | data model |
| Email provider | — | delivery | — | F-007 invite by email |

## Key flows

### Create project

<sub>sxl: F-003.AC1 · F-003.AC2</sub>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant W as Web
  participant A as API
  participant D as DB
  U->>W: Submit "New project"
  W->>A: POST /projects
  A->>D: insert (check R-01)
  alt over limit
    A-->>W: 422 { code: "limit_reached" }
    W-->>U: inline error (S-03 validation-error)
  else ok
    A-->>W: 201 Project
    W-->>U: go to S-04
  end
```
